name: TabBunny
type: Actual Chrome extension UI, recorded as step-by-step frames
fixture: Disposable profile; fictional example URLs and article text

steps.title: Keep your place in one click
steps.caption: No naming or selecting. Save this window keeps your web links; current tabs stay open.

steps.title: Your bunny kept the links
steps.caption: The date is filled in for you. No setup or account needed.

steps.title: Same window? No duplicate pile
steps.caption: Saving the same links refreshes the latest snapshot.

steps.title: Tomorrow: pick up where you left off
steps.caption: Resume opens the saved links in a new window. Page edits and login state are not snapshots.

steps.title: Organize only when you need to
steps.caption: Named projects, selected tabs and backup controls are optional.
